# Getting started with V6: Meet your new console and sandbox

Join us for a first look at Assemble – the console where your team configures every interface.ai product, governs every change, and tracks the analytics. No ticket, no queue, no waiting.

We’ll also take you inside your V6 sandbox. It’s a full V6 environment of your own, walled off from production – where your team can configure, test and get comfortable before any change reaches a member.

Who’s speaking

## Who you’ll learn from.

![Eliot Gable](https://interface.ai/_next/image?url=%2Flp%2Fwebinar-registration%2Feliot-gable.webp&w=3840&q=75&dpl=dpl_7SxGrS45vF4fFWZRZ8Y3SLx57Chc)

### Eliot Gable

Principal Product Manager · interface.ai

With 25 years in industry and more than 10 in banking, Eliot’s work spans product design, AI, information security, telephony and networking – with forty years of development experience behind it. He’s been close to v6 since the start, so he’ll be taking you through the latest developments.

![Sanket Shahane](https://interface.ai/_next/image?url=%2Flp%2Fwebinar-registration%2Fsanket-shahane.webp&w=3840&q=75&dpl=dpl_7SxGrS45vF4fFWZRZ8Y3SLx57Chc)

### Sanket Shahane

Sr. Product Manager · interface.ai

With close to a decade building AI products – from search at Lucidworks to founding the product function at bookend.ai – Sanket’s work spans agentic AI, product-led growth, and 0-to-1 scaling. He’s the Sr. Product Manager behind interface.ai’s agentic platform, and he’ll walk through what’s new.

What you’ll learn

## What’s on the agenda.

Assemble is where V6 configuration lives, and your team runs it. This session covers what you can change directly, how a change gets from edit to product, and how your sandbox gives you room to try it all first before your members see it.

1. 01

### What is Assemble


The single console behind every interface.ai product – configuration, governance and analytics in one place.

2. 02

### What you can configure yourself


Intents and primary actions, verification rules, routing, schedules, knowledge, and so much more – all decided and done by you.

3. 03

### How to get the most out of it


Where customers see the return fastest – closing knowledge gaps, same-day changes, and the analytics that show it working.

4. 04

### A walkthrough of your V6 sandbox


A live demo of the sandbox that’s now yours, and how it lets your team test everything before launch.


## Your console. Your sandbox. Your call.

Join us live on either Sept 17 or Oct 1 and explore the new possibilities with interface.ai.
